description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI skill icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, in this order left to right then top to bottom, each centered in its own cell: a chunky brown boulder flying right with a short dust trail; cracked ground splitting in a star pattern with yellow stun stars; a straight row of sharp brown stone spikes erupting from the ground; a sturdy wall of stacked grey stone blocks seen from the front; three heavy brown boulders tumbling down from above; a heavy iron-banded stone weight beside a bold outward push arrow; a round shield made of rough grey stone plates; a dark brown orb pulling small rocks inward toward it; a mountain peak with a small glowing green heart at its summit. Color theme: warm brown stone, ochre earth and grey rock with small moss green accents. Chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bold readable silhouettes, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art UI icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, one icon centered per grid cell on magenta. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
